clauses.reason: The order exempts Ales Hrdlicka, Curator of Physical Anthropology in the United States National Museum, Smithsonian Institution, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending March 31, 1942". The recital says Ales Hrdlicka had been exempted from compulsory retirement for age for periods totaling two years by Executive Orders No. 8058 of February 23, 1939, and No. 8368 of March 7, 1940; those earlier orders precede this one and are not events of it. The end is recorded as March 31, 1942 (1942-03-31), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative.
